changelog:
Initial release of threads-user-posts skill.

- Enables extraction of public posts from any Threads user profile, including post text, engagement metrics, and media information.
- Uses SSR-embedded JSON for initial post loading; supports scroll-triggered pagination to fetch more posts.
- Requires a logged-in browser session for reliable access (login wall enforced in most regions as of 2026).
- Handles profile pages, scroll-based pagination, and error scenarios such as login walls and private or deleted accounts.
- Provides structured post data including post ID, text, URL, counts (likes, replies, reposts), media info, and author details.
summary: Fetches public posts from a Threads user's profile page, extracting post text, engagement metrics, and media info from SSR-embedded JSON.
